title: Master bus has a limiter
requires_reason: an iZotope plugin is on the master - rerun with plugin_state=True to read its Maximizer/Limiter
rationale: A limiter catches peaks before export and sets the ceiling.
remediation: Add a limiting stage as the last master device (a Limiter, or Ozone's Maximizer in its chain); ceiling ~-1 dB.

title: Master limiter ceiling at or below -1 dB, true-peak safe
requires_reason: no readable master limiter (none present, or iZotope state not read - use plugin_state=True)
evidence_template: {limiting.source}: ceiling {limiting.ceiling_db} dB, true-peak safe {limiting.true_peak_safe}, target {limiting.target_lufs} LUFS
rationale: Lossy codecs and DACs reconstruct inter-sample peaks above a sample-peak ceiling; -1 dBTP with true-peak (intersample) limiting keeps streaming encodes clean. Compare the target loudness with the project brief.
remediation: Set the ceiling to -1 dB and enable true-peak limiting (Ozone Maximizer: Margin -1, Prevent Intersample Clipping on).

title: Master bus has some processing
rationale: A completely flat master is rarely export-ready.
remediation: Consider gentle bus EQ/compression and a limiter on the master.

title: Integrated loudness in streaming target range
rationale: Streaming platforms normalize near -14 LUFS; -16..-8 is a sane master window.
remediation: Adjust master gain / limiter ceiling toward your target (e.g. -14 LUFS).

title: True peak below -1 dBTP
rationale: Inter-sample peaks above -1 dBTP can clip on lossy codecs and DACs.
remediation: Lower the limiter ceiling to -1 dBTP or below.
